{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 with NaN
df['biomarker_baseline'] = df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
df_severe = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for SEVERE patients, excluding NaN values
mean_biomarker_severe = df_severe['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_biomarker_severe"}
